coordinate_system: All anchors, rects and clip_polygon vertices are full-sheet SOURCE pixels. Rectangles x,y,width,height. Convert to crop-local only at export.
authorship: All hands, feet, crowns, roots and sheath anchors individually observed in current gray QA; inferred occluded left grips explicitly labelled. No images generated or edited.
angle_convention: Blade tip up0, clockwise positive. Grip axis from inferred/visible left pommel grip toward right guard grip.
hand_identity: Anatomical right near arm originates screen-left shoulder, often crosses toward screen-right fist. Right hand nearest guard, left nearest pommel. Never swap hands to force clearance.
measurement_notes: Standing-equivalent body_height510 ruler estimated from head/trunk/straightened limb segments, held constant in each clip. Source selection derived from each observed connected body silhouette, expanded2px to preserve edges. Charged_slam4/5 visibly overlap and cannot be fully isolated without repair.
